remarks: Welcome to this delightful apartment nestled within a meticulously cared-for elevator building, providing 1,000 square feet of cozy living space right in the heart of Cos Cob. Go onto your private balcony and soak in the surroundings. Inside, discover a bright and welcoming interior boasting cathedral ceilings, encompassing a spacious living room, a fully-equipped kitchen, a serene bedroom featuring a walk-in closet, and a pristine bathroom. Enjoy the comfort of central air conditioning and the convenience of indoor garage parking complemented by outdoor parking options. Situated in the perfect locale, you're just moments away from the park, shops, school, and train station, making this the ultimate urban retreat.
